visual_contract.human_rule: visible cockpit, maintenance logic and deliberate weapon/tool mounts
visual_contract.machine_rule: no crew volume, construction-equipment ancestry, replaceable task-specific tools
visual_contract.rejection: no heroic giant robot, fantasy mecha, generic glowing spider or decorative neon

runtime_animation.walk_gait: four authored frames per mech at 7-9 fps
runtime_animation.damage_states: shared physical smoke, spark and critical-fire attachments driven by real hull ratio
